metadata.title: Urban Hip-Hop Group Portrait with Distressed Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A multi-layered urban group portrait featuring a desaturated graffiti backdrop and a three-tier typographic hierarchy with distressed and script elements.
triggerTerms: urban group portrait with graffiti wall
hip-hop album cover layout with script subtitle
excludeWhen: clean minimalist corporate photography is required
bright pastel color palettes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: Four male figures in streetwear posed against a high-contrast, desaturated graffiti wall, featuring a central typographic stack that blends distressed serif, clean sans-serif, and elegant script styles.
coreVisualRelationships: Figures overlap a complex, textured monochromatic background
Typography is centered horizontally over the lower third of the subjects
Color contrast between the desaturated background and the warm-toned skin and clothing of the subjects
Hierarchical text scaling from large distressed display to medium sans-serif to small script
coreInvariants: High-contrast desaturated graffiti or street-art background texture
Three-tier typographic stack with distinct font styles for each level
Subjects positioned in a horizontal line with varying heights and poses

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects occupy the full width of the frame, scaled from waist-up to full-body visibility.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, distressed 'CALI' text serves as the primary visual anchor in the lower-center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the subjects' faces down to the bold central text, then follow the typographic hierarchy to the bottom script.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the frame is densely packed with figures and background texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated charcoal and grey (background and shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted earth tones and denim blues (clothing)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the background textures.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a gritty, desaturated tonal range

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of heavy slab serif, geometric sans-serif, and formal copperplate script.
letterConstructionRules: Top tier: Heavy slab serif with eroded, stencil-like textures and palm tree silhouettes integrated into the glyphs.
Middle tier: Clean, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif with uniform stroke weight.
Bottom tier: High-contrast formal script with decorative flourishes.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'I' in the top tier is replaced or merged with a stylized palm tree graphic.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast-driven: Distressed heavy serif paired with clean wide sans-serif and delicate script.

avoid: Modernist sans-serif for the top tier

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif structure with room for erosion effects.
Provides the clean, geometric contrast needed for the middle tier.
Captures the formal, elegant flourish of the bottom tier.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group portrait of four men in urban streetwear standing against a high-contrast, desaturated grey graffiti wall. Lighting should be dramatic with warm skin tones.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three levels of text centered at the bottom: a large distressed slab-serif top word, a medium wide-tracked sans-serif middle line, and a small elegant script bottom line.

verificationChecks: Is the top text distressed and textured?
Is the middle text widely tracked?
Is the background desaturated compared to the subjects?
Are the palm tree elements integrated into the typography?

adjustableVariables: Level of distress on the display typography
mustRedesign: Avoid using exact brand logos from the original
Ensure the palm tree graphic is a generic silhouette
Do not replicate specific facial features of the original subjects
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is legible despite the distress
Verify the three distinct font styles are present
Ensure the subjects do not blend too much into the background
Confirm the horizontal centering of the typographic stack
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Graffiti Backdrop + [Distressed Serif / Wide Sans / Script] Typographic Stack
